item.title: Dolphin Progress Release 2603
item.description:
📝 Any time a game accessed memory mapped with a page table, the other way to map memory on the GameCube, Dolphin would always have to manually translate it. On a memory starved machine, an extra 66% of memory is extremely tempting. When the game resumes, the memory access will return data as if it were stored in valid memory all along.
🔗 Read more: https://dolphin-emu.org/blog/2026/03/12/dolphin-progress-report-release-2603/

item.title: Avoiding Trigonometry (2013)
item.description:
📝 The function will look something like this: mat3x3 rotationAxisAngle( const vec3 & v, float a ) { const float si = sinf( a ); const float co = cosf( a ); const float ic = 1. And so, in the end, your code looks like this: const vec3 axi = normalize( cross( z, d ) ); const float ang = acosf( clamp( dot( z, d ), -1. 0f ) ); const float co = cosf( ang ); const float si = sinf( ang ); const float ic = 1.
🔗 Read more: https://iquilezles.org/articles/noacos/

item.title: US private credit defaults hit record 9.2% in 2025, Fitch says
item.description:
📝 US private credit defaults hit record 9. In its monitor of 302 companies with outstanding private credit debt, Fitch recorded 38 defaults among 28 different borrowers. Yet Fitch recorded no defaults in the software sector last year.
🔗 Read more: https://www.marketscreener.com/news/us-private-credit-defaults-hit-record-9-2-in-2025-fitch-says-ce7e5fd8df8fff2d
